description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6150013348041 WIRING HARNESS,BRAN: Line 0001 Qty 6 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0258 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 5. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0WW63 H16DW910-26; 1DA92 H16DW910-26; 27456 H16DW910-26; 67291 H16DW910-26. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
